reason: Legacy mode-1 source can reference grid_z(NN+1) after the NN scan. The legacy grid carries implicit lower-face geometry, whereas explicit soil_water_parameter_set_t exposes only n node-center z values. A direct typed HeadCalc trial with active_nodes==n would therefore cross the unresolved LOW01-G2 z(n+1) seam.

corrected_live_scope.allowed: INSIDE_PROFILE with 1 <= active_richards_nodes < n, away from node-snap and branch boundaries
corrected_live_scope.refused: ABOVE_OR_AT_TOP, BELOW_PROFILE, branch boundaries, node-snap cases, and INSIDE_PROFILE cases with active_richards_nodes==n

classification_scope: The pure source-derived classifier may still characterize the NN=n lower-half-cell regime. This amendment only forbids executing that regime through direct explicit-geometry HeadCalc until G2 has a typed lower-face geometry owner.
added_gate: OUTPUT01 refuses a representative lower-half-cell control (H_phreatic=-275 cm for the frozen four-node geometry) before HeadCalc is called.
nonclaims: does not change legacy mode-1 physics
does not narrow the eventual LOW01 design; it narrows only the current research execution envelope
forbidden: do not synthesize z(n+1) inside HeadCalc
do not execute active_nodes==n through the direct typed carrier
do not alter the frozen LOW01-B NN=1/2/3 controls
